DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 38 s. 2022 May 16, 2022 Con Cern concern032022@gmail.com Sir/Madam: This has reference to your electronic mail dated March 31 , 2022 regarding the propriety of the approval of a DILG Undersecretary on the attendance of barangay officials to seminars outside the geographical area and outside the province. DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2011-59 entitled "LOCAL GOVERNMENT- ORGANIZED OR FUNDED TRAINING, SEMINAR, WORKSHOP OR SIMILAR ACTIVITY' was issued on April 25, 2011 by the late DILG Secretary Jesse M. Robredo discouraging local chief executives and presiding officers of sanggunians to conduct trainings, seminars, workshops or similar activities in places outside of their official stations or territorial jurisdictions funded out of public funds. The objective of said issuance was clearly stated therein, that is, said practice delimits actions of the local government units to bring about their mandate to provide quality life for all as the additional funds spent for said activities could have financed desirable development programs and projects. However, while it is true that under MC No. 2011-59 provides that local chief executives and presiding officers are discouraqed to conduct seminars, workshops, trainings, or other similar activities outside the geographical area where the concerned local government unit is located, however, we would like to highlight that these activities can still be undertaken provided that there is strict compliance with existing budgeting, accounting, and auditing rules and regulations, specifically to Commission on Audit (COA) Circular No. 85-55-AI dated 08 September 1985 on the prevention of the incurrence of irregular, unnecessary, excessive or extravagant expenditures or uses of government funds and properties. For as long as the concerned local officials can justify that their conduct of seminars, workshops, trainings, or other similar activities outside their qeoqraphical area comply with the COA Circular averting the incurrence of irregular, unnecessary, excessive or extravagant expenditures or uses of government funds and properties, said training or seminar may be validly conducted, such as in this case, by the League of Accountant in the Municipality of Batangas Inc., and the Barangay Treasures, Chairman Committee on Appropriation, and other barangay officials and officers may join and take part in said activity. 1 Amended Rules and Regulations on the Prevention of Irregular, Unnecessary, Excessive or Extravagant Expenditures or Uses of Funds and Property "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Notwithstanding, we would like to stress that the opinion of this level is based solely on the facts and representations narrated in the e-mail, other attached documents, and our appreciation of the same, and is being issued without prejudice to any contrary opinion, decisions, and orders of competent authorities or courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: AN Unders e ary for Local Government OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/rjki/clp Page 2 of 2
